question: Mumtaz Khan was named ‘FIH Women’s Rising Star of the Year’ in 2022. She plays which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumtaz Khan** was named 'FIH Women's Rising Star of the Year' in 2022.
 
• She is a talented player in the sport of **Hockey**.
 
• This recognition is awarded by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**.
 
• Mumtaz Khan's performance has been outstanding, contributing significantly to her team's success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Hockey Federation (FIH)** is the governing body for the sport of hockey worldwide.
 
• The FIH Women's Rising Star of the Year award recognizes young and upcoming talent in women's hockey.
 
• This award aims to encourage young players to continue their development in the sport.
 
• Mumtaz Khan's achievement highlights her potential and the bright future of Indian women's hockey.
